content: {"reasoning":"The claim was denied CO-197 because required authorization was absent, and Silverbridge offers neither retroactive authorization nor peer-to-peer review. A necessity appeal has already been attempted, and resubmission or patient billing would not cure the authorization failure or create valid patient responsibility under a contractual-obligation denial. With the payer path exhausted and no collectible contractual patient share established, the balance should be closed.","action":"write_off"}
